usage.summary: Source-directory trailing slash gives contents at the selected destination depth; shell expansion is distinct. Host/module root syntax is an exception to needing a slash.

recursion.summary: Recursive scan; both peers >=3.0.0 normally use incremental recursion, while delay-updates and some deletion modes disable it.

dry_run.summary: No-change trial; itemized outputs should agree subject to caveats. v3.2.7 uses an intentional-trickery/system-call caveat; live manual spells out external source/destination changes. No byte-transfer or performance oracle from dry-run statistics.

delete.summary: Extraneous receiver files, synchronized directory scope, whole-directory arguments, recursion or dirs condition, sender-only exclusions and delete-excluded exception, sender I/O suppression and ignore-errors exception. For 3.2.7 peers default deletion timing is during transfer.

delete_excluded.summary: Unqualified rules lose receiver effects; explicit receiver or both-side qualifiers remain valid. The candidate speaks about ordinary excludes, so does not incorrectly erase this exception.

sender_removal.summary: remove-source-files concerns successfully duplicated sending-side non-directories, with quiescence and size/mtime safeguards. Candidate names the distinct operation but does not prescribe it.

itemized_oracle.summary: Itemized change format includes a deletion message. At target 3.2.7 the proposed preview can identify deletion paths; dry-run is not evidence that transfer, cancellation, or publication occurred.

delay_updates.summary: Held temporary files renamed successively, not a single tree commit. Conflicts with inplace/append; full-list memory and extra destination disk; partial-dir naming/mount conditions. These are relevant if enabling it; candidate does not require enabling it.

first_match.summary: First matching rule governs, so a later include cannot overturn an already matching exclude. FILTER debug is a prospective diagnostic, not an executed check here.

two_sided_filters.summary: Default sender hide/show and receiver protect/risk, qualified by rule applicability/order.

filter_types_and_patterns.summary: Exclude is hide+protect, protect is receiver-only; leading slash anchors; trailing triple-star covers directory and descendants; modifiers affect sides, perishability and domain.

transfer_root.summary: Global anchoring uses transfer root; source slash and relative mode alter root/path mapping. Per-directory merge-file anchors differ.

exit_values.summary: Success is zero; interrupt, partial transfer, vanished source and timeout have nonzero exit codes. Blocking publication on any nonzero outcome is a conservative product rule, not an rsync publish feature.

implementation_first_match.summary: check_filter walks the ordered list and returns on the first matching applicable entry; inspected as text, not executed.

implementation_pattern.summary: Matcher treats leading slash as anchored and triple-star suffix as also matching a directory.

release_context.summary: Upstream release document identifies 3.2.7 and 20 October 2022. It records a filtering-validation fix; that is not proof of deployed binaries or every 2026 platform behavior.

faq_shell.summary: Startup output contaminates a remote-shell data stream; direct daemon connections without a remote shell have a different daemon-side diagnostic. Supplemental, not necessary to fix the six critique items.

version_policy: P1/P4/P5 are retrieved from the upstream v3.2.7 tag with saved-byte SHA-256. P2/P3 are live unpinned and are not evidence of endpoint versions. Source tag/content identity is distinct from installed-peer verification.
read_scope: Full assigned input/corpus/candidate/source-map/every candidate source member. Upstream primary files inspected at the mapped relevant sections; do not claim entire 4,842-line manual or historical NEWS was semantically audited.
executed_operations: SHA-256 and byte comparison of frozen inputs
